changeSet.author: lexavault
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO tenant_redaction_catalog (tenant_id, kind_key, enabled, updated_at) SELECT k.tenant_id, k.kind_key, k.enabled, k.updated_at FROM tenant_redaction_kinds k JOIN tenant_redaction_policies p ON p.tenant_id = k.tenant_id WHERE k.kind_key IN ('BANK_ROUTING_NUMBER', 'BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER', 'ITIN', 'EIN', 'DRIVERS_LICENSE_NUMBER', 'PASSPORT_NUMBER'); INSERT INTO tenant_redaction_policies (tenant_id, auto_redact_threshold, review_mode, ssn_enabled, date_of_birth_enabled, credit_card_number_enabled, credit_score_enabled, mask_ssn_last_four, updated_at) SELECT t.id, 0.80, 'UNCERTAIN_ONLY', true, true, true, true, true, now() FROM tenants t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_redaction_policies p WHERE p.tenant_id = t.id); UPDATE tenant_redaction_policies SET locked_items_on = false; INSERT INTO tenant_redaction_catalog (tenant_id, kind_key, enabled, updated_at) SELECT p.tenant_id, v.kind_key, v.enabled, p.updated_at FROM tenant_redaction_policies p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('SSN', p.ssn_enabled), ('DATE_OF_BIRTH', p.date_of_birth_enabled), ('CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER', p.credit_card_number_enabled), ('CREDIT_SCORE', p.credit_score_enabled)) AS v (kind_key, enabled);
